sections.Profile:
"Flying Saucers" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. on October 27, 1950, with a production run of 745 units. Designed by Steve Kordek, the game features two flippers, one pop bumper, and seven kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Space Fantasy, Single Player, Wood Rail, Space, Original Theme, Space Ships, Sci-Fi
